reviews.text: I’ve been using that app for a few weeks now paid £35 for what?  dont even connect to Apple Watch ? The ai features is useless just keep giving same exercises 🙄 maybe use the £35 to update the app would like a full refund of possible there’s better free app out ✌🏻

reviews.title: Free trial not long enough
reviews.text: If you have faith in your product then a realistic 2 week trial would persuade me to invest my time in really giving this a go. 3 days is a pathetically short time to investigate an app like this.

reviews.title: Thumbs down
reviews.text: Unless you are perfectly fit without any physical issues in the body, this app is not appropriate. I’ve had 2 knee surgeries and an SI joint instability, this app, unlike others does not accommodate the limitations. It would be helpful if it did. Unfortunately I’m stuck paying a yearly fee for something I’ve already cancelled.

reviews.title: Not good for advanced trainees
reviews.text: The starting screens are irritatingly patronising especially the “I promise to workout x days a week with symmetry”. As if I haven’t been training for 7 years basically never missing a training session. I wanted to use this app to log my progress and get an idea of how I’m improving month to month but from the first few screens it seems like the app thinks it’s going to revolutionise my physique in a few months time. This turned my BS alarms on so hard that I deleted the app right there. It has potential go be a really cool tool but the TikTokified “insane body transformation” branding is a huge turn off. Respect your users and they might stick around.

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: Do not buy it will randomly log you out of your account, convert all your weight to a different unit, and completely screw up your progress. Switching back to writing in my notes as this app messes up all your stats.
